WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the current inventory version for set 5004718-1
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '5004718-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents: parts, nested sets, and minifigs
-- We track the multiplier from quantities along the nesting path
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS unit_multiplier,
        FALSE AS is_from_minifig
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Direct nested sets from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        ec.part_num,
        ec.color_id,
        ec.unit_multiplier * is2.quantity AS unit_multiplier,
        ec.is_from_minifig
    FROM inventory_sets is2
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON is2.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = is2.set_num
    JOIN (
        -- Get current inventory for each nested set
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) iv ON iv.set_num = is2.set_num AND i.version = iv.max_version
    JOIN exploded_contents ec ON TRUE
    -- We need to join with the nested set's inventory parts
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    WHERE ip.part_num IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs from the set's inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.unit_multiplier * im.quantity AS unit_multiplier,
        TRUE AS is_from_minifig
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        -- Get current inventory for each minifig
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) iv ON iv.set_num = im.fig_num AND i.version = iv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS unit_multiplier, FALSE AS is_from_minifig) ec
),
-- Proper recursive explosion: start with the set, then recurse through nested sets and minifigs
recursive_explosion(inventory_id, part_num, color_id, quantity, depth) AS (
    -- Base: parts directly in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity,
        0
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets: find the set's current inventory and its parts
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        re.quantity * is2.quantity * ip.quantity,
        re.depth + 1
    FROM recursive_explosion re
    JOIN inventories i ON i.id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories nested_inv ON nested_inv.set_num = is2.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON latest.set_num = is2.set_num AND nested_inv.version = latest.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = nested_inv.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs: find the minifig's current inventory and its parts
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        re.quantity * im.quantity * ip.quantity,
        re.depth + 1
    FROM recursive_explosion re
    JOIN inventories i ON i.id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = re.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories minifig_inv ON minifig_inv.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) latest ON latest.set_num = im.fig_num AND minifig_inv.version = latest.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = minifig_inv.id AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn
        FROM inventories
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
target_color AS (
    SELECT id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Flat Silver'
),
-- parts directly in each 2014 set's current inventory
direct AS (
    SELECT ci.set_num AS root_set, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN target_color tc ON tc.id = ip.color_id
    WHERE s.year = 2014 AND ip.is_spare = false AND ip.part_num = '53451'
),
-- nested sets inside 2014 sets (recursive expansion of set nesting)
nested AS (
    SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, iset.set_num AS child_set, iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE s.year = 2014
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n.root_set, iset.set_num, n.qty * iset.quantity
    FROM nested n
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = n.child_set
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
),
nested_parts AS (
    SELECT n.root_set, n.qty * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM nested n
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = n.child_set
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN target_color tc ON tc.id = ip.color_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false AND ip.part_num = '53451'
),
-- minifigs directly in 2014 sets
direct_figs AS (
    SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, im.fig_num, im.quantity AS qty
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE s.year = 2014
),
-- minifigs inside nested sets
nested_figs AS (
    SELECT n.root_set, im.fig_num, n.qty * im.quantity AS qty
    FROM nested n
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = n.child_set
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
),
all_figs AS (
    SELECT root_set, fig_num, qty FROM direct_figs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT root_set, fig_num, qty FROM nested_figs
),
fig_parts AS (
    SELECT af.root_set, af.qty * ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM all_figs af
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = af.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN target_color tc ON tc.id = ip.color_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false AND ip.part_num = '53451'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_units
FROM (
    SELECT qty FROM direct
    UNION ALL
    SELECT qty FROM nested_parts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT qty FROM fig_parts
) x;

current_inventory AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = 'BAM2020-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents: parts, nested sets, and minifigs
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from the current inventory (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: parts from minifigs in the current inventory
    SELECT 
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT inventory_id, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) miv ON mi.set_num = (SELECT set_num FROM inventories WHERE id = mi.id)
    JOIN inventories mi_current ON mi_current.set_num = mi.set_num 
        AND mi_current.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = mi.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mi_current.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.part_num,
        ec.color_id,
        iset.quantity * ec.total_quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

    JOIN inventories ni ON ni.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE ni.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = iset.set_num)

    -- Start with the set's current inventory parts
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        1 AS level
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = 'BAM2020-1' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1)

    SELECT

        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity AS total_quantity,

    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mi.id

      AND mi.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = im.fig_num)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode nested sets
    SELECT 
        re.part_num,
        re.color_id,
        iset.quantity * re.total_quantity AS total_quantity,

    JOIN inventories ni ON ni.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN recursive_explosion re ON re.level >= 1

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM inventory_parts tip

current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) as max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with set 71746-1's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        1 as quantity_multiplier,
        'set' as item_type,
        ci.set_num as item_id
    FROM current_inventory ci
    WHERE ci.set_num = '71746-1'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add parts directly in the inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * ip.quantity,
        'part' as item_type,
        ip.part_num || '|' || ip.color_id::VARCHAR as item_id
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    INNER JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ec.inventory_id
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'set'
        AND ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets
    SELECT 
        ci.id as inventory_id,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * iset.quantity,
        'set' as item_type,
        iset.set_num as item_id
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    INNER JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ec.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE ec.item_type = 'set'

    FROM inventory_sets iset
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON iset.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = iset.set_num
    -- Get current inventory of nested set (highest version)
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version

    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN exploded e ON e.part_num IS NOT NULL  -- dummy

,

    -- Direct parts
    SELECT 
        'part' AS item_type,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS multiplier,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS child_set_num,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS child_fig_num
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
      AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL

        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,

        NULL AS child_fig_num
    FROM inventory_sets iset

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        im.quantity AS multiplier,
        NULL AS child_set_num,
        im.fig_num AS child_fig_num
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    WHERE im.inventory_id = (SELECT inventory_id FROM current_inventory)
),

-- Recursive expansion

    -- Base: items from the initial inventory
    SELECT 
        item_type,
        part_num,
        color_id,
        multiplier,
        child_set_num,
        child_fig_num,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS depth
    FROM inventory_items

        END AS item_type,

        (rc.child_fig_num IS NOT NULL AND i.set_num = rc.child_fig_num)

  FROM explode x
  JOIN edges e ON e.parent_kind = x.child_kind AND e.parent_num = x.child_num

)

WITH RECURSIVE set_contents(set_num, part_num, color_id, quantity) AS (
    -- Direct parts in the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        s.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity
    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(i2.version)
        FROM inventories i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = s.set_num
    )
    AND ip.is_spare = false

    UNION ALL

    -- Parts from nested sets
    SELECT 
        sc.set_num,
        sc2.part_num,
        sc2.color_id,
        sc2.quantity * ins.quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = sc.set_num
    JOIN set_contents sc2 ON sc2.set_num = ins.set_num
    WHERE ins.inventory_id = (
        SELECT i.id
        FROM inventories i
        WHERE i.set_num = sc.set_num
        ORDER BY i.version DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )

    UNION ALL

    -- Parts from minifigs
    SELECT 
        sc.set_num,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity * imf.quantity
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs imf ON imf.inventory_id = (
        SELECT i.id
        FROM inventories i
        WHERE i.set_num = sc.set_num
        ORDER BY i.version DESC
        LIMIT 1

    WHERE mi.version = (
        SELECT MAX(mi2.version)
        FROM inventories mi2
        WHERE mi2.set_num = imf.fig_num
    )
    AND ip.is_spare = false
)

    WHERE i.version = (

        FROM inventories i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = s.set_num

    -- Recursive: minifigs inside nested sets

        sc.root_set,
        sc.qty * ins.quantity AS qty,
        im2.fig_num AS fig_num
    FROM set_contents sc
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = sc.fig_num  -- fig_num is actually a set_num for nested sets

    SELECT 
        ci.set_num as item_id,
        'set' as item_type,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

        NULL as sub_item_id,
        NULL as sub_item_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num as item_id,
        'set' as item_type,
        NULL as part_num,
        NULL as color_id,
        NULL as quantity,
        iset.set_num as sub_item_id,
        iset.quantity::BIGINT as sub_item_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num as item_id,
        'set' as item_type,
        NULL as part_num,
        NULL as color_id,
        NULL as quantity,
        im.fig_num as sub_item_id,
        im.quantity::BIGINT as sub_item_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifig parts
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num as item_id,
        'fig' as item_type,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity::BIGINT as quantity,
        NULL as sub_item_id,
        NULL as sub_item_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ci.set_num LIKE 'fig-%' OR ci.set_num IN (SELECT fig_num FROM minifigs)
),
explosion AS (
    -- Start with set 5003832-1, quantity 1
    SELECT 
        '5003832-1' as item_id,
        1::BIGINT as multiplier,
        0 as level
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively find sub-items and multiply quantities
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(ip.sub_item_id, ip.item_id) as item_id,
        (e.multiplier * COALESCE(ip.sub_item_quantity, 1))::BIGINT as multiplier,
        e.level + 1

WITH RECURSIVE
-- current inventory version per parent
cur AS (
  SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
  FROM u_composition
  GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
-- edges from current inventories only
edges AS (
  SELECT c.parent_kind, c.parent_num, c.child_kind, c.child_num, c.color_id, c.qty, c.is_spare
  FROM u_composition c
  JOIN cur ON cur.parent_kind = c.parent_kind AND cur.parent_num = c.parent_num AND cur.v = c.version
),
-- explode each set's contents
explode AS (
  SELECT s.set_num AS root_set, e.child_kind, e.child_num, e.color_id, e.qty AS qty, e.is_spare
  FROM sets s
  JOIN edges e ON e.parent_kind = 'set' AND e.parent_num = s.set_num
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x.root_set, e.child_kind, e.child_num, e.color_id, x.qty * e.qty, e.is_spare
  FROM explode x
  JOIN edges e ON e.parent_kind = x.child_kind AND e.parent_num = x.child_num
  WHERE x.child_kind IN ('set','minifig')
),
-- aggregate per set: does it contain the minifig and the part (non-spare)
agg AS (
  SELECT root_set,
         MAX(CASE WHEN child_kind = 'minifig' AND child_num = 'fig-000506' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_fig,
         MAX(CASE WHEN child_kind = 'part' AND child_num = '98138' AND is_spare = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_part
  FROM explode
  GROUP BY root_set
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_sets
FROM agg

WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get the current inventory version for set 75373-1
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num, 1 AS quantity
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '75373-1'
    AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '75373-1')
),

recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with the set's current inventory
    SELECT inventory_id, set_num, quantity
    FROM current_inventory
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively expand nested sets
    SELECT 
        child_inv.id AS inventory_id,
        child_inv.set_num,
        rc.quantity * iset.quantity AS quantity
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = rc.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories child_inv ON child_inv.set_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE child_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = child_inv.set_num
    )
),

all_parts AS (
    -- Parts directly in set inventories (not spare)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        rc.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = rc.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts from minifigs (current inventory, not spare)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        rc.quantity * im.quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = rc.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories minifig_inv ON minifig_inv.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = minifig_inv.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    AND minifig_inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = minifig_inv.set_num
    )
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the current inventory for the target set
target_inventory AS (
    SELECT id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num = '3000067584-1'
    ORDER BY version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Recursively find all nested contents: sets and their inventories
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct contents of target set's inventory
    SELECT 
        iset.set_num AS child_set_num,
        iset.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    JOIN target_inventory ti ON iset.inventory_id = ti.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets within sets
    SELECT 
        iset2.set_num AS child_set_num,
        rc.multiplier * iset2.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = rc.child_set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset2 ON iset2.inventory_id = inv.id
    WHERE inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = rc.child_set_num
    )
),
-- All set inventories to consider (target set + all nested sets)
all_set_inventories AS (
    -- Target set's inventory
    SELECT ti.inventory_id, 1 AS multiplier
    FROM target_inventory ti
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- All nested sets' current inventories
    SELECT 
        inv.id AS inventory_id,
        rc.multiplier
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventories inv ON inv.set_num = rc.child_set_num
    WHERE inv.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = rc.child_set_num
    )
)
-- Sum minifig quantities from all inventories, applying multipliers
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(im.quantity * asi.multiplier), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM all_set_inventories asi
JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = asi.inventory_id;

exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as qty

    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, color_id, qty, is_spare
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM u_composition uc2
        WHERE uc2.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind
          AND uc2.parent_num = uc.parent_num
    )

    -- Direct parts in sets
    SELECT parent_num AS set_num, child_num AS part_num, color_id
    FROM current_inventory
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND child_kind = 'part' AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts inside nested sets
    SELECT e.set_num, ci.child_num, ci.color_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.parent_kind = 'set' AND ci.parent_num = e.part_num
    WHERE ci.child_kind = 'part' AND ci.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts inside minifigs (directly in set or nested)

    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND ci.parent_num = e.part_num
    WHERE ci.child_kind = 'part' AND ci.is_spare = FALSE

set_minifig_links AS (

WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get the current (highest version) inventory for each set/fig
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with set 43205-1's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.id AS inventory_id,
        1 AS quantity_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type,
        s.set_num AS item_id
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN sets s ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
    WHERE s.set_num = '43205-1'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        ci.id AS inventory_id,
        ec.quantity_multiplier * COALESCE(is2.quantity, im.quantity) AS quantity_multiplier,
        CASE WHEN is2.set_num IS NOT NULL THEN 'set' ELSE 'minifig' END AS item_type,
        COALESCE(is2.set_num, im.fig_num) AS item_id
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ec.inventory_id = ci.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON is2.inventory_id = ci.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE is2.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
),
all_parts AS (

        ip.part_num,

WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Racers'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_tree tt ON t.parent_id = tt.id
),
sets_2012 AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2012
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM theme_tree)
),
-- Recursive explosion of set contents
exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from the set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        s.set_num AS root_set,
        s.set_num AS current_set,
        uc.child_num AS part_num,
        uc.qty AS qty
    FROM sets_2012 s
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
        AND uc.parent_num = s.set_num
        AND uc.child_kind = 'part'
        AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
        AND uc.version = (
            SELECT MAX(version) 
            FROM u_composition uc2 
            WHERE uc2.parent_kind = 'set' 
              AND uc2.parent_num = s.set_num
        )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: parts from nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        e.current_set,
        uc.child_num AS part_num,
        e.qty * uc.qty AS qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
        AND uc.parent_num = e.current_set
        AND uc.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
        AND uc.version = (
            SELECT MAX(version) 
            FROM u_composition uc2 
            WHERE uc2.parent_kind = 'set' 
              AND uc2.parent_num = e.current_set
        )
    JOIN u_composition uc_parts
        ON uc_parts.parent_kind = uc.child_kind
        AND uc_parts.parent_num = uc.child_num
        AND uc_parts.child_kind = 'part'
        AND uc_parts.is_spare = FALSE
        AND uc_parts.version = (
            SELECT MAX(version) 
            FROM u_composition uc3 
            WHERE uc3.parent_kind = uc.child_kind 
              AND uc3.parent_num = uc.child_num
        )
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT uc.child_kind AS child_kind, uc.child_num AS child_num
    ) AS child_info
    WHERE uc_parts.parent_num = child_info.child_num
),
-- Sum quantities per root set
set_part_counts AS (
    SELECT root_set, SUM(qty) AS total_parts
    FROM exploded
    GROUP BY root_set
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_parts), 2) AS avg_parts
FROM set_part_counts;

    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id

    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mci.inventory_id

        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

        'part' AS item_type,

        NULL AS fig_num
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nested sets in inventories

        iset.inventory_id,
        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        iset.quantity,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.set_num AS nested_set_num,

-- First, get the color_id for Trans-Light Blue
target_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id 
    FROM colors 
    WHERE name = 'Trans-Light Blue'
),

-- Get current inventory for each set (highest version)
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num,
        i.version
    FROM inventories i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        WHERE set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents at any level
-- We track: the original set, current item being processed, and quantity multiplier
exploded AS (
    -- Base case: start with sets that have current inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.set_num AS current_item,
        'set' AS item_type,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        ci.inventory_id AS current_inventory_id
    FROM current_inventories ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case 1: nested sets (from inventory_sets)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS current_item,
        'set' AS item_type,
        e.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        ci2.inventory_id AS current_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON e.current_inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON iset.set_num = ci2.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case 2: minifigs (from inventory_minifigs)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        im.fig_num AS current_item,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        ci3.inventory_id AS current_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.current_inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci3 ON im.fig_num = ci3.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),

-- Get all parts from exploded items
-- Parts from sets and minifigs (which have inventories)
all_parts AS (
    -- Parts from set inventories (including nested sets)
    SELECT

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- First, get the color_id for Trans-Light Blue
target_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id 
    FROM colors 
    WHERE name = 'Trans-Light Blue'
),

-- Get current inventory for each set (highest version)
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num,
        i.version
    FROM inventories i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        WHERE set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),

-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents at any level
-- We track: the original set, current item being processed, and quantity multiplier
exploded(root_set, current_item, item_type, qty_multiplier, current_inventory_id) AS (
    -- Base case: start with sets that have current inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.set_num AS current_item,
        'set' AS item_type,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        ci.inventory_id AS current_inventory_id
    FROM current_inventories ci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case 1: nested sets (from inventory_sets)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS current_item,
        'set' AS item_type,
        e.qty_multiplier * iset.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        ci2.inventory_id AS current_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON e.current_inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci2 ON iset.set_num = ci2.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case 2: minifigs (from inventory_minifigs)
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        im.fig_num AS current_item,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        e.qty_multiplier * im.quantity AS qty_multiplier,
        ci3.inventory_id AS current_inventory_id
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON e.current_inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventories ci3 ON im.fig_num = ci3.set_num
    WHERE e.item_type = 'set'
),

    -- Parts from set inventories (including nested sets)

        e.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,

    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.current_inventory_id = ip.inventory_id

        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        e.qty_multiplier * ip.quantity AS total_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON e.current_inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE e.item_type = 'minifig'
    AND ip.is_spare = false
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the color ID for Dark Bluish Gray
dark_bluish_gray AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Dark Bluish Gray'
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
current_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.set_num,
        i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive expansion of set contents
expanded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in set inventories (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ci.inventory_id = ip.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: parts from minifigs in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT fig_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY fig_num
    ) mmv ON mi.set_num = mmv.fig_num AND mi.version = mmv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mi.id = mip.inventory_id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM expanded_contents ec

WITH RECURSIVE set_contents AS (
    -- Base case: sets that directly contain the minifig in their current inventory
    SELECT 
        i.set_num AS containing_set,
        im.fig_num,
        im.quantity
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON i.id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE im.fig_num = 'fig-004629'
      AND i.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version) 
          FROM inventories 
          WHERE set_num = i.set_num
      )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: sets that contain nested sets which lead to the minifig
    SELECT 
        i.set_num AS containing_set,
        sc.fig_num,
        iset.quantity * sc.quantity
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON i.id = iset.inventory_id
    JOIN set_contents sc ON iset.set_num = sc.containing_set
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version) 
        FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = i.set_num
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT containing_set AS set_num
FROM set_contents
ORDER BY containing_set;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory IDs for sets
current_set_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num)
        id AS inventory_id,
        set_num
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),
-- Get current inventory IDs for minifigs
current_minifig_inventories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (fig_num)
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num AS fig_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num IN (SELECT fig_num FROM minifigs)
    ORDER BY i.set_num, i.version DESC
),
-- Recursive expansion: find all sets that directly or indirectly contain the target minifig
sets_with_minifig AS (
    -- Base case: sets that directly contain the minifig in their inventory
    SELECT 
        im.inventory_id,
        s.set_num,
        1 AS depth
    FROM inventory_minifigs im
    JOIN current_set_inventories csi ON im.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    JOIN sets s ON csi.set_num = s.set_num
    WHERE im.fig_num = 'fig-001686'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: sets that contain a nested set which (at any depth) contains the minifig
    SELECT 
        iset.inventory_id,
        s.set_num,
        swm.depth + 1
    FROM inventory_sets iset
    JOIN current_set_inventories csi ON iset.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    JOIN sets s ON csi.set_num = s.set_num
    JOIN sets_with_minifig swm ON iset.set_num = swm.set_num
)
SELECT DISTINCT set_num
FROM sets_with_minifig
ORDER BY set_num;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get the current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM inventories i1
    WHERE version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories i2 WHERE i2.set_num = i1.set_num)
),
-- Get color_id for Blue
blue_color AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Blue'
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents of a set
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts in set inventories (excluding spare parts)
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base case: parts from minifigs in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories mci ON mci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mci.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * ip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: nested sets containing minifigs
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        ec.total_quantity * im.quantity * mip.quantity AS total_quantity
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON ci.set_num = ec.part_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventories mci ON mci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mci.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT root_set) AS num_sets
FROM exploded_contents ec
JOIN blue_color bc ON bc.color_id = ec.color_id
WHERE ec.part_num = '6153b'

WITH RECURSIVE set_contents AS (
    -- Base case: sets that directly contain the minifig in their current inventory
    SELECT 
        s.set_num,
        im.fig_num,
        im.quantity
    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) as max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) current_inv ON i.set_num = current_inv.set_num AND i.version = current_inv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON i.id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE im.fig_num = 'fig-006038'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive case: sets that contain nested sets which eventually contain the minifig
    SELECT 
        s.set_num,
        sc.fig_num,
        sc.quantity * is2.quantity
    FROM sets s
    JOIN inventories i ON s.set_num = i.set_num
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) as max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) current_inv ON i.set_num = current_inv.set_num AND i.version = current_inv.max_version
    JOIN inventory_sets is2 ON i.id = is2.inventory_id
    JOIN set_contents sc ON is2.set_num = sc.set_num
)
SELECT DISTINCT set_num
FROM set_contents
ORDER BY set_num;
```

),

current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM inventories i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
    )
),

exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: direct parts from set inventories (excluding spare parts)

        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS multiplier

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get the color ID for Dark Blue
dark_blue AS (
    SELECT id AS color_id FROM colors WHERE name = 'Dark Blue'
),
-- Get current inventory IDs for all sets
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT 
        i.id AS inventory_id,
        i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) v ON i.set_num = v.set_num AND i.version = v.max_version
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents of sets
-- We track: the original set we're exploring from, the current inventory we're in, and the multiplier
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base case: start with all sets and their direct inventory parts
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        ci.set_num AS current_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS multiplier,
        FALSE AS is_nested_set,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS nested_set_num
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add nested sets: sets inside sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS current_set,
        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        ec.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier,
        TRUE AS is_nested_set,
        iset.set_num AS nested_set_num
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = ec.current_set 
        ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    WHERE ec.is_nested_set = FALSE OR ec.nested_set_num IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Add minifigs: minifigs inside sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        im.fig_num AS current_set,
        NULL AS part_num,
        NULL AS color_id,
        ec.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier,
        TRUE AS is_nested_set,
        im.fig_num AS nested_set_num
    FROM exploded_contents ec
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = ec.current_set 
        ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    WHERE ec.is_nested_set = FALSE OR ec.nested_set_num IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets/minifigs to their parts
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ec.nested_set_num AS current_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ec.multiplier * ip.quantity AS multiplier,
        FALSE AS is_nested_set,

        SELECT id FROM inventories 
        WHERE set_num = ec.nested_set_num 
        ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    WHERE ec.is_nested_set = TRUE AND ec.nested_set_num IS NOT NULL
    AND ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find all themes under 'Agents' (including itself)
agents_themes AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Agents'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN agents_themes at ON t.parent_id = at.id
),
-- Sets in Agents theme (including sub-themes) released in 2014
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num, s.name
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2014 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM agents_themes)
),
-- Current inventory for each set
current_inventories AS (
    SELECT i.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    WHERE i.set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
),
-- Recursive expansion of contents
-- We track: inventory_id, the item type, item identifier, quantity multiplier
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct minifigs in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        im.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: nested sets in set inventories
    SELECT 
        ci.set_num AS root_set,
        iset.set_num AS item_id,
        'set' AS item_type,
        iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM current_inventories ci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON ci.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets -> their minifigs
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        im.fig_num AS item_id,
        'minifig' AS item_type,
        rc.qty * im.quantity AS qty
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON rc.item_id = ci.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON ci.inventory_id = im.inventory_id
    WHERE rc.item_type = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets -> their nested sets
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        iset.set_num AS item_id,
        'set' AS item_type,
        rc.qty * iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN current_inventories ci ON rc.item_id = ci.set_num
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON ci.inventory_id = iset.inventory_id
    WHERE rc.item_type = 'set'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM recursive_contents
WHERE item_type = 'minifig';

    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2018 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM gear_themes)

    FROM inventories i
    JOIN (

        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.item_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
),
-- Recursive expansion of contents
-- We track: inventory_id, the item we're expanding, and the multiplier from parent quantities
expanded_contents AS (
    -- Base: start with target sets, find their current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.id AS inventory_id,
        ci.item_num,
        1 AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.item_num = ts.set_num
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Parts directly in inventory
    SELECT 
        ip.inventory_id,
        ip.part_num AS item_num,
        ip.quantity * ec.qty_multiplier AS qty_multiplier,

        iset.quantity * ec.qty_multiplier AS qty_multiplier,
        'set' AS item_type
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ec.inventory_id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.item_num = iset.set_num
    WHERE ec.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
    
    UNION ALL

        ci.item_num,

    WHERE ec.item_type IN ('set', 'minifig')
)

super_heroes_dc_themes AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Super Heroes DC'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN super_heroes_dc_themes s ON t.parent_id = s.id
),
-- Get all sets in 2019 in those themes
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2019
      AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM super_heroes_dc_themes)
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
set_current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inventory_id, i.set_num
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN target_sets ts ON i.set_num = ts.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (
        SELECT MAX(version)
        FROM inventories i2
        WHERE i2.set_num = i.set_num
    )
),
-- Recursive CTE to explode all contents
-- We track: inventory_id (the set we're currently exploding), multiplier (quantity along path)
exploded AS (
    -- Base: start with target sets, multiplier 1
    SELECT sci.set_num AS root_set, sci.inventory_id, 1::BIGINT AS multiplier
    FROM set_current_inventory sci
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets
    SELECT e.root_set, 
           (SELECT i.id 
            FROM inventories i 
            WHERE i.set_num = iset.set_num 
              AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
           ) AS inventory_id,
           e.multiplier * iset.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
    WHERE iset.set_num NOT IN (SELECT fig_num FROM minifigs)  -- sets only, not minifigs
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into minifigs
    SELECT e.root_set,
           (SELECT i.id 
            FROM inventories i 
            WHERE i.set_num = im.fig_num 
              AND i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
           ) AS inventory_id,
           e.multiplier * im.quantity AS multiplier
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = e.inventory_id
),
-- Get all inventory_ids with their multipliers for each root set
all_inventories AS (
    SELECT root_set, inventory_id, multiplier
    FROM exploded
    WHERE inventory_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Sum up all parts
parts_sum AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.multiplier * ip.quantity), 0) AS total_parts
    FROM all_inventories a
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = a.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
)

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get current inventory IDs for sets
current_set_inventory AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (set_num) id AS inventory_id, set_num
    FROM inventories
    WHERE set_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)
    ORDER BY set_num, version DESC
),

-- Recursive expansion of set contents
expanded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts in set inventory (not spare)
    SELECT 
        csi.set_num AS root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity AS total_quantity,
        FALSE AS is_minifig_path
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: direct minifigs in set inventory
    SELECT 
        csi.set_num AS root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        (im.quantity * mip.quantity) AS total_quantity,
        TRUE AS is_minifig_path
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mi.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        (ec.total_quantity * iset.quantity * ip.quantity) AS total_quantity,
        ec.is_minifig_path
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ec.part_num ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    JOIN current_set_inventory csi ON csi.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = FALSE
    AND ec.part_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)  -- only expand if it's a set
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets -> minifigs
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        (ec.total_quantity * iset.quantity * im.quantity * mip.quantity) AS total_quantity,
        TRUE AS is_minifig_path
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = (
        SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ec.part_num ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    JOIN current_set_inventory csi ON csi.set_num = iset.set_num
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    JOIN inventories mi ON mi.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = mi.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = FALSE
    AND ec.part_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM sets)  -- only expand if it's a set
),

-- Get all sets that contain the minifig fig-000506 (at any level)
sets_with_minifig AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT root_set
    FROM expanded_contents
    WHERE is_minifig_path = TRUE
    AND root_set IN (
        -- Also check direct minifig containment
        SELECT csi.set_num
        FROM current_set_inventory csi
        JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
        WHERE im.fig_num = 'fig-000506'
    )
    
    UNION
    
    -- Direct minifig containment
    SELECT csi.set_num AS root_set
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.inventory_id
    WHERE im.fig_num = 'fig-000506'
),

-- Get all sets that contain part 98138 (in any colour, at any level, not through minifig path for the part itself)
sets_with_part AS (

    SELECT t.id FROM themes t
    JOIN juniors_themes j ON t.parent_id = j.id
),
-- Get all sets from 2018 in Juniors theme (including sub-themes)
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2018
    AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM juniors_themes)
),
-- Find current inventory version for each set
set_current_version AS (
    SELECT parent_num AS set_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),
-- Find current inventory version for each minifig
minifig_current_version AS (
    SELECT parent_num AS fig_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'minifig'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),
-- Recursive expansion: start with direct contents of target sets (current inventory)
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct inventory lines of target sets (current version only)
    SELECT 
        ts.set_num AS root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.qty AS total_qty,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM target_sets ts
    JOIN set_current_version scv ON ts.set_num = scv.set_num
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
        AND uc.parent_num = ts.set_num 
        AND uc.version = scv.version
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        rc.root_set,
        child.child_kind,
        child.child_num,
        rc.total_qty * child.qty AS total_qty,
        child.color_id,
        child.is_spare
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN LATERAL (
        -- If current item is a set, get its current inventory
        SELECT 
            uc.child_kind,
            uc.child_num,
            uc.qty,
            uc.color_id,
            uc.is_spare,
            'set' AS parent_kind
        FROM u_composition uc
        JOIN set_current_version scv ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
            AND uc.parent_num = rc.child_num 
            AND uc.version = scv.version
        WHERE rc.child_kind = 'set'
        UNION ALL
        -- If current item is a minifig, get its current inventory
        SELECT 
            uc.child_kind,
            uc.child_num,
            uc.qty,
            uc.color_id,
            uc.is_spare,
            'minifig' AS parent_kind
        FROM u_composition uc
        JOIN minifig_current_version mcv ON uc.parent_kind = 'minifig' 
            AND uc.parent_num = rc.child_num 
            AND uc.version = mcv.version
        WHERE rc.child_kind = 'minifig'
    ) child ON true
    WHERE rc.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')
)
-- Sum quantities of all parts (non-spare) across all target sets
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0)::BIGINT AS total_parts
FROM recursive_contents
WHERE child_kind = 'part'

    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'minifig'
    GROUP BY parent_num

        c.child_num,

    -- Base: direct contents of each set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        ci.parent_num as root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.qty as multiplier,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM current_inventory ci
    JOIN u_composition uc ON ci.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind 
        AND ci.parent_num = uc.parent_num 
        AND ci.max_version = uc.version
    WHERE ci.parent_kind = 'set'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        ec.root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        ec.multiplier * uc.qty as multiplier,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.is_spare
    FROM expanded_contents ec
    JOIN current_inventory ci 
        ON ci.parent_kind = ec.child_kind 
        AND ci.parent_num = ec.child_num
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON ci.parent_kind = uc.parent_kind 
        AND ci.parent_num = uc.parent_num

        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.qty as qty,
        uc.child_kind = 'part' as is_direct_part,
        1 as depth
    FROM u_composition uc
    CROSS JOIN current_version cv
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
      AND uc.parent_num = '71837-1'
      AND uc.version = cv.version
      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        ep.qty * uc.qty as qty,
        FALSE as is_direct_part,
        ep.depth + 1
    FROM exploded_parts ep
    JOIN u_composition uc ON (
        -- For nested sets: join on set's current inventory
        (ep.child_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_num = ep.child_num
         AND uc.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM u_composition WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = ep.child_num))

         AND uc.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM u_composition WHERE parent_kind = 'minifig' AND parent_num = ep.child_num))
    )

      AND ep.child_kind != 'part'  -- Don't recurse from parts
),

        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN child_kind = 'part' THEN qty ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_parts_qty
    FROM exploded_parts
    WHERE child_kind = 'part'  -- Only count actual parts in final totals
)

SELECT

        WHEN total_parts_qty = 0 THEN 0.00

WITH s, i
ORDER BY i.version DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH direct_parts, nested_parts
WITH direct_parts + nested_parts AS all_parts
UNWIND all_parts AS combo
RETURN count(DISTINCT combo) AS distinct_part_colour_combinations

WITH RECURSIVE
current_inv AS (
    SELECT id, set_num
    FROM (
        SELECT id, set_num, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) AS rn
        FROM inventories
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
exploded AS (
    -- direct parts of each current inventory
    SELECT ci.set_num AS root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, ip.quantity::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM current_inv ci
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- nested sets
    SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, e.qty * ip.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.root_set
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = ins.set_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    -- minifigs
    SELECT e.root_set, ip.part_num, ip.color_id, e.qty * ip.quantity
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.fig_num = e.root_set
    JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num)
FROM sets s
JOIN current_inv ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num
JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
JOIN parts p ON p.part_num = ip.part_num
JOIN colors c ON c.id = ip.color_id
WHERE p.part_num = '4865b' AND c.name = 'Lime' AND ip.is_spare = false

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find all themes under 'Collectible Minifigures' (including itself)
theme_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Collectible Minifigures'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
-- Get all sets in 2024 under Collectible Minifigures theme
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
    WHERE s.year = 2024
),
-- Get current inventory for each set
set_current_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.set_num, i.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventories i
    JOIN target_sets ts ON i.set_num = ts.set_num
    WHERE i.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = i.set_num)
),
-- Recursive expansion: find all minifigs in a set's inventory, including nested sets
-- We track: the top-level set, current inventory being explored, and quantity multiplier
recursive_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct minifigs in each set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        sci.set_num AS top_set,
        im.fig_num,
        im.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_current_inventory sci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: nested sets in each set's current inventory
    SELECT 
        sci.set_num AS top_set,
        iset.set_num AS fig_num,  -- we'll treat nested sets as needing further expansion
        iset.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_current_inventory sci
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets
    -- A nested set (from previous step where fig_num is actually a set_num) needs its inventory expanded
    SELECT 
        rc.top_set,
        COALESCE(im.fig_num, iset.set_num) AS fig_num,
        rc.qty * COALESCE(im.quantity, iset.quantity) AS qty
    FROM recursive_contents rc
    JOIN inventories i ON i.set_num = rc.fig_num
    -- Get current inventory version for this nested set
    JOIN (
        SELECT set_num, MAX(version) AS max_version
        FROM inventories
        GROUP BY set_num
    ) mv ON i.set_num = mv.set_num AND i.version = mv.max_version
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = i.id
    WHERE rc.fig_num NOT IN (SELECT fig_num FROM minifigs)  -- only expand if it's a set, not a minifig
),
-- Filter to only actual minifigs and sum
minifig_totals AS (
    SELECT top_set, fig_num, qty
    FROM recursive_contents
    WHERE fig_num IN (SELECT fig_num FROM minifigs)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Also include direct minifigs that weren't caught (in case no nested sets)
    SELECT sci.set_num AS top_set, im.fig_num, im.quantity AS qty
    FROM set_current_inventory sci
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = sci.inventory_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_minifigs
FROM minifig_totals;
